newsitem.title: SYRIA: Three killed, 19 injured in Syria bus accident.
newsitem.headline: Three killed, 19 injured in Syria bus accident.

text.p: Three people were killed and 19 injured when a bus collided with a truck near Hama city, some 210-km (130-miles) north of Damascus due to heavy fog, the official Syrian news agency SANA said on Tuesday.
It said the accident took place on Monday on a highway close to Hama and the injured were recovering at the Hama national hospital.
"The governor and police commander of Hama visited the injured at the hospital on Tuesday and were briefed on their condition," SANA said.
